title: Fixed Open Yokes and Front Pin Articulator
description: One newly authored whole static empty articulator-style professional display. A continuous open lower mounting frame on four full pads supports two rear uprights and one retained transverse hinge axle. A separate complete open upper yoke is fixed at a shallow raised angle; two blank opposed mounting discs leave the middle empty rather than carrying teeth or casts. A long front vertical pin passes visually through a complete forward guide and lands on a finite sloped lower table, with separate fixed stop and side lock-wheel exteriors. Three opaque solid PBR materials, one prop zero scenes. New full geometry, not a bench vise without jaws or a waffle machine without mould squares. Static external appearance only: no dental casts, teeth, patient, diagnosis, occlusion or anatomical accuracy, calibration, adjustment range, clinical operation, moving mechanism, gripping, manufacture or safety performance. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
